name: Khwaja Salimullah
contribution: Khwaja Salimullah was central to late-colonial Muslim elite politics in Bengal and is closely associated with the Dhaka context of the All-India Muslim League founding period.
context: Late colonial Bengal, especially Dhaka-centered Muslim political mobilization in the early 20th century.
impact: His patronage networks and organizational role influenced constitutional and communal politics that later shaped partition-era trajectories.
